Compared with the image of [[Son Of Skywalker (V)#Source formats|Son Of Skywalker (V) (Playtest)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif commit 3d2c89e]) and [[Son Of Skywalker (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif commit efc26cd]).
